_comment: Curated layer for the `surface` section of docs/capabilities.json (discoverability-design.md §1.2). stapel-social is a COMPOSITE PRESET (projections-and-composition §3): INSTALLED_APPS/urls/config wiring over stapel-chat + stapel-profiles + stapel-reviews. It has no gate registry and no docs/schema.json — provides/axes/extension_points/requires stay hand-written and are NOT drift-gated here. `surface_roots` is deliberately empty: apps.py has no permission classes, no public functions, no capability fields and no templates of its own — the composite's whole job is transparent glue, so there is nothing here a product should call INSTEAD of reaching into the member modules (stapel-chat, stapel-profiles, stapel-reviews) directly. `make contract` still refreshes module/version from pyproject and would fail loudly the moment this module grows a real symbol without an intent line for it.
